issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: TouchGrass
products.tagline: Context-aware break reminders without invasive permissions
products.summaryZh: 无需侵入权限的上下文感知休息提醒
products.descriptionZh: TouchGrass 是一款专为 macOS 打造的上下文感知休息提醒工具。大多数休息提醒只知道一件事：时间。TouchGrass 会等待会议、通话、媒体播放和屏幕录制结束，将你离开 Mac 的时间计为已完成休息，并在长时间打字后提醒你眨眼、改善坐姿和休息。所有功能均在本地运行，无需辅助功能权限，尊重你的工作流程。提供 7 天免费试用，之后一次性购买价格为 3.99 美元，包含终身更新。
products.description: TouchGrass is a context-aware break reminder built for macOS. Most break reminders only know one thing: time. TouchGrass waits through meetings, calls, media playback and screen recordings, counts time away from your Mac as a completed break, and reminds you to blink, improve your posture and rest after long typing sessions. Everything runs locally, never asks for Accessibility permission, and respects your workflow. 7 day free trial, then a one time purchase of $3.99 with lifetime updates.

products.name: Athena by Shoplazza
products.tagline: An orchestrator agent for your entire commerce stack
products.summaryZh: 一个面向整个商业栈的编排代理
products.descriptionZh: Athena 帮助你搭建一个精致、可随时上线的商店，包含完整的页面、产品和本地化文案。在此基础上，它通过批量创建产品、设置折扣、配置物流和启动广告活动，持续推动业务运转。支付、物流、履约和会员体系都集成在同一平台中，因此 Athena 创建的商店不仅是一个门面，更是一个可以真正运营的商业实体。
products.description: Athena helps you build a polished, launch-ready store with complete pages, products, and localized copy. From there, it keeps the business moving by creating products in bulk, setting up discounts, configuring shipping, and launching ad campaigns. Payments, logistics, fulfillment, and loyalty are built into the same platform, so the store Athena creates is not just a storefront. It is ready to operate as a real business.

products.name: Openbase
products.tagline: Manage your team of AI agents by voice, from anywhere
products.summaryZh: 随时随地，用语音管理你的AI智能体团队。
products.descriptionZh: Openbase 让你通过语音管理 AI 编程代理团队，不受地点限制；无需屏幕，无需办公桌。AI 代理可以异步工作，但监督它们仍会让你回到笔记本电脑前。OpenBase 解决了这个问题。只需通过语音即可分配任务、在代理工作过程中引导它们，并批准更改。这些代理能编写代码、控制你的电脑、创建 PR、提交并推送；你通过手机保持控制。它跨提供商工作，并同步到你的机器，这样你可以在办公桌前从上次中断的地方继续。
products.description: Openbase lets you manage a team of AI coding agents by voice, from anywhere; no screen, no desk. AI agents can work async, but supervising them still pulls you back to a laptop. OpenBase fixes that. Dispatch tasks, steer agents mid-work, and approve changes just by talking. The agents write code, control your computer, open PRs, commit and push; you stay in control from your phone. Works across providers and syncs to your machine, so you pick up at your desk right where you left off.

products.name: SF Apartment Finder
products.tagline: Tinder for live SF rentals from across the web
products.summaryZh: 全网的旧金山租房实时信息，像刷Tinder一样浏览
products.descriptionZh: Criblist将旧金山找房体验变成可滑动浏览的卡片。设定预算、区域和必备条件后，即可浏览来自Craigslist及本地物业经理的实时房源。Context.dev提供数据提取与源数据支持。收藏心仪房源即可。
products.description: Criblist turns SF apartment hunting into a swipeable deck. Set your budget, neighborhoods, and must-haves, then browse live rentals from Craigslist and local property managers. Context.dev powers the extraction and source data. Keep the good ones.

products.name: Aymo AI
products.tagline: All-in-one AI Platform for Teams
products.summaryZh: 一站式AI平台，赋能团队协作
products.descriptionZh: 在一个安全的工作区内，即可使用GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok、Kimi、GLM等最新模型及45余款顶尖AI模型，并配备强大的团队协作功能。可并排对比不同AI模型的输出结果，支持文件上传与对话、联网搜索、图像生成，以及在任何方案中与团队协作。免费及优质方案可替代十余款AI工具：配套Chrome扩展、应用程序、实用AI工具，AI文档功能即将上线。
products.description: Get access to latest models of GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Kimi, GLM and 45+ top AI models in one secure workspace with powerful team features. Compare outputs AI model response side by side, upload and chat with files, search the web, generate images, and collaborate with your team on every plan. Free and decent plans that can replace a dozen AI tools: Bundled with a Chrome extension, apps, useful AI tools, and AI Docs on the way.

products.name: PureBox.ai
products.tagline: Review-first AI cleanup for your real Gmail inbox.
products.summaryZh: 以审查为先的AI清理工具，专为你的真实Gmail收件箱设计。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数收件箱工具都要求你先设置规则。PureBox 跳过了这一步——从首次扫描起，它就会利用 AI 和你自己的 Gmail 历史记录（你打开过哪些发件人、回复过哪些、或让哪些邮件堆积起来）进行个性化设置，因此从第一天起，建议就贴合你的日常习惯。每条建议都会说明原因，未经你批准不会移动任何内容——没有黑箱操作，也不会静默删除。它呈现的是需要你关注的内容，而不仅仅是该丢弃的。你的数据绝不会被出售；Pro 订阅是其资金来源。
products.description: Most inbox tools make you build rules first. PureBox skips that - it's personalized from your first scan using AI and your own Gmail history (which senders you open, reply to, or let pile up), so suggestions fit your routine on day one. Every suggestion shows why, and nothing moves until you approve - no black box, no silent deletions. It surfaces what needs your attention, not just what to trash. Your data is never sold; Pro subscriptions fund it.

products.name: BrainFeed
products.tagline: A personalized learning feed that redirects your scroll
products.summaryZh: 个性化学习信息流，重新引导你的浏览方向
products.descriptionZh: BrainFeed 是一款个性化学习推送工具，旨在引导你的滑动习惯，构建复利式知识积累。设定自定义目标，例如“如何获取首批100名用户”，或粘贴你一直拖延未读的长文章或YouTube视频链接。BrainFeed 会将其转化为卡片形式的短小可滑动推送，让你在排队时轻松消化。与传统推送不同，BrainFeed 采用间隔重复机制，确保你真正记住所读内容。
products.description: BrainFeed is a personalized learning feed designed to redirect your scrolling habit and build compounding knowledge. Set a custom goal like "how to get my first 100 users," or drop in a link to that long article or YouTube video you’ve been avoiding. BrainFeed transforms them into a bite-sized, scrollable feed of cards that you can easily get through while waiting in a line. Unlike traditional feeds, BrainFeed uses spaced repetition to ensure you actually retain what you read.

products.name: Forgeon
products.tagline: Create, publish, and experience interactive stories
products.summaryZh: 创作、发布并体验互动故事
products.descriptionZh: 每一代人都在重新定义故事的讲述方式。我们相信，书籍将是下一个变革的载体。Forgeon 是一个平台，作者可以在此创作包含选择、RPG 机制、音乐、插画等元素的互动故事。我们不打造 AI 作者——我们为创作者提供更好的工具。我们相信，书籍可以像任何游戏、电影或剧集一样引人入胜。
products.description: Every generation reinvents the way stories are told. We believe books are next. Forgeon is a platform where authors create interactive stories with choices, RPG mechanics, music, illustrations, and more. We don't build AI authors—we build better tools for creators. We believe books can be as engaging as any game, movie, or series.

products.name: Pulse Island
products.tagline: A living island for your Mac's notch
products.summaryZh: Mac 灵动岛的灵动绿洲
products.descriptionZh: Pulse 将 MacBook 的刘海屏变为动态岛：音乐、会议、剪贴板、天气、专注计时器、设备及实时系统状态，只需一瞥即可尽收眼底。
products.description: Pulse turns your MacBook's notch into a Dynamic Island: Be it music, meetings, clipboard, weather, focus timers, devices and live system stats, one glance up.

products.name: KeyOpera 2.0
products.tagline: Make every Mac keystroke sound uniquely yours
products.summaryZh: 让每一次Mac键盘敲击声都成为你的专属印记
products.descriptionZh: KeyOpera 为你的 Mac 添加令人愉悦的键盘和鼠标音效。V2 版本引入自定义键包音效包、一键访达安装、用于创建和控制音效包的 Homebrew 命令行工具、按键名称语音播报、改进的 VoiceOver 支持以及重新设计的菜单。
products.description: KeyOpera adds satisfying keyboard and mouse sounds to your Mac. V2 introduces customkeypak sound packs, one-click Finder installs, a Homebrew CLI for creating and controlling packs, spoken key names, improved VoiceOver support, and a redesigned menu.

products.name: yatta!
products.tagline: A cute little to-do list that celebrates with you
products.summaryZh: 一个可爱的小待办清单，陪你一起庆祝。
products.descriptionZh: 一款可爱小巧的待办清单，每当你完成一项任务，角色就会用烟花和一声欢快的"yatta！"（日语中"我做到了！"）来庆祝。只有三个选项：今天、稍后或某天。没有项目、没有优先级、没有杂乱。核心功能免费，完全离线使用。
products.description: A cute, tiny to-do list where a character celebrates every task you finish — with fireworks and a happy "yatta!" ("I did it!" in Japanese). Just three choices: Today, Later, or Someday. No projects, no priorities, no clutter. Free core features, fully offline.

products.name: CodexBar Lite
products.tagline: Privacy-first Codex tracker for your macOS menu bar
products.summaryZh: 隐私优先的 Codex 追踪器，适用于 macOS 菜单栏
products.descriptionZh: CodexBar Lite 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏应用，让你随时掌握 OpenAI Codex 的使用情况。它直接使用你现有的 Codex CLI 会话，无需浏览器 Cookie、钥匙串权限、API 密钥或第三方账户。通过这款轻量级开源应用，即可监控使用量、重置时间并接收通知。
products.description: CodexBar Lite is a native macOS menu bar app that keeps your OpenAI Codex usage visible at a glance. It uses your existing Codex CLI session - no browser cookies, Keychain permissions, API keys, or third-party accounts required. Monitor usage, reset times, and receive notifications, all from a lightweight, open-source app.

products.name: >=PlayingFild
products.tagline: Productivity Tool & Tab Manager that Understands Context
products.summaryZh: 生产力工具与标签管理器，理解上下文
products.descriptionZh: PlayingFild 通过设备端机器学习按内容分类标签页，而非 URL。同一网站可能因页面不同而具有生产力或干扰性。分类过程完全在设备端完成，原始页面内容、HTML 及个人文本不会离开浏览器。通过专注工作赚取休息时间，并在需要时使用。标签页会根据实际使用情况自动重新排序，未使用的标签页将被关闭。功能包括：按窗口规则、专注计时模式、回顾卡片及生产力分析。
products.description: ≻=PlayingFild uses on device machine learning to classify tabs by content, not URL. The same website can be productive or distracting based on the page. Classification happens entirely on your device. Raw page content, HTML and personal text don't leave your browser. Earn break time by focusing and spend it when you need it. Tabs reorder themselves based on what you actually use, and unused tabs close. Includes per window rules, focus timer modes, recap cards, and productivity analytics.

products.name: AppUFO
products.tagline: Ship localised Apps faster
products.summaryZh: 更快地发布本地化应用
products.descriptionZh: 无需耗费数日或数百美元进行应用本地化，即可触达全球更多用户。数分钟内完成Xcode项目本地化，降低翻译成本，减少字符串管理时间，让您专注于打造卓越应用。
products.description: Reach more users worldwide without spending days or hundreds on app localisation. Localise your Xcode projects in minutes, reduce translation costs, and spend less time managing strings so you can focus on building great apps.

products.name: Pawesome
products.tagline: Your AI Native Inbound Marketing Engine
products.summaryZh: 你的AI原生集客营销引擎
products.descriptionZh: Pawesome 是一个完全AI原生的B2B SaaS入站引擎：内容引擎、线索收集和分析，构建于了解您公司业务的大脑之上。
products.description: Pawesome is a full AI-native inbound engine for B2B SaaS: Content Engine, Lead Collection, and Analytics, built on a brain that knows your company.

products.name: Via 1.0
products.tagline: Find the optimal path through your work
products.summaryZh: 找到工作中的最优路径
products.descriptionZh: 计划很少能按部就班地执行。会议时间变动、优先级调整、工作量持续增加。你的注意力弥足珍贵，Via 能帮你找到该投入的方向。只需将想法倾泻而出，Via 的 AI 便会将其转化为切实可行的时间表，将最高优先级的工作填入每一个可用时段。当日程发生变化时，你的时间表也会即时更新。Via 会为你规划出最优工作路径，让你始终清楚下一步该做什么，充分利用每一分钟。
products.description: Days rarely go according to plan. Meetings move, priorities shift, and workload keeps growing. Your attention is precious, and Via shows you where to invest it. Simply brain dump your thoughts and Via's AI turns this into a realistic schedule, slotting highest-priority work into every available pocket of time. When your day changes, your schedule updates instantly. Via finds the optimal path through your work, so you always know what to do next, and make the most of the time you have.

products.name: Maptoolkit.org - free vector map server
products.tagline: Stunning vector maps. Zero cost. No sign-up, no API key.
products.summaryZh: 惊艳的矢量地图。零成本。无需注册，无需API密钥。
products.descriptionZh: Maptoolkit.org 是一个基于 OpenStreetMap 和 MapLibre 构建的免费、生产级矢量瓦片服务器。它提供快速、可定制的矢量底图，支持 3D 地形、山体阴影和户外样式——注重隐私保护，无需注册、无需 API 密钥、无 Cookie 使用，且对开源、独立开发者及小企业项目无请求限制。
products.description: Maptoolkit.org is a free, production-grade vector tile server built on OpenStreetMap and MapLibre. It delivers fast, customizable vector basemaps with 3D terrain, hillshading, and outdoor styles - privacy-aware with no sign-up, no API keys, no cookies, and no request limits for open-source, indie, and small-business projects.

products.name: AlsonAI Studio for Animated Shorts
products.tagline: From bedtime story to animated short film.
products.summaryZh: 从睡前故事到动画短片。
products.descriptionZh: AlsonAI将原创故事转化为插画书——现在还能制作动画短片。借助全新的Gemini Omni视频管线，创作者能让角色活起来，生成电影级场景、书籍预告片、朗读视频、YouTube Shorts、Reels以及课堂展示内容。先创作书籍，再让故事动起来。
products.description: AlsonAI turns original stories into illustrated books—and now animated shorts. With our new Gemini Omni-powered video pipeline, creators can bring characters to life as cinematic scenes, book trailers, read-aloud videos, YouTube Shorts, Reels, and classroom showcases. Create the book, then watch the story move.

products.name: Prompt Anything: No more AI slop
products.tagline: Become an expert prompt engineer in minutes, for anything AI
products.summaryZh: 几分钟内成为专家级提示工程师，适用于任何AI场景。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数AI输出效果不佳，根源在于底层提示词薄弱。Prompt Anything解决了这一问题。用自然语言描述需求，它就能构建专业提示词：涵盖代理、网页应用、图像、视频、代码和文案等13种模式。智能提问捕捉你的上下文，再通过成本优化路由选择合适模型。一次生成即可获得80%到100%的构建成果，节省数周时间和大量token。我们的吉祥物Quill全程引导。免费开始，无需信用卡。
products.description: Most AI output is weak because the prompt underneath is weak. Prompt Anything fixes that. Describe what you want in plain English and it builds the expert prompt: 13 modes for agents, web apps, images, video, code, and copy. Smart questions capture your context, then cost-optimized routing picks the right model. You get 80 to 100 percent of the build in one shot, saving weeks and a pile of tokens. Quill, our mascot, guides you the whole way. Free to start, no credit card.

products.name: Yoggi
products.tagline: Safe AI chat for kids
products.summaryZh: 面向儿童的安全AI聊天
products.descriptionZh: Yoggi 是为3至15岁儿童打造的AI助手。提供适龄回答、实时语音对话、图像生成、严格内容过滤及家长控制功能。iOS和Android平台免费使用。
products.description: Yoggi is the AI assistant built for children aged 3–15. Age-adapted answers, live voice chat, image generation, strict content filtering, and parental controls. Free on iOS and Android.
